title: People are complaining that Apple Store sales systems went down on new iPhone release day, and they can't get their new phones (AAPL)
text: People are complaining that Apple Store sales systems went down on new iPhone release day, and they can't get their new phones (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Sep 21, 2018, 4:24 pm 6 pts Apple's newest phones, the iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max, went on sale on Friday. One way to make sure you get the latest iPhone or Apple Watch on launch day is to reserve the new phone through the Apple Store app, and then head to a physical Apple store to pick it up.
